author: JackCooper
quote: I will start with the good first, although the good won't save this game. On the technical level the game is great. The graphics and the environments look amazing. But that's really it, an eye candy. The story and gameplay is disappointing. The core of a single player game is the story and gameplay. I came for GTA game and instead got a dating simulator. Moreover, Jason is a piece of cardboard personality wise and Lucia is just a horrible person. If i want a dating simulator i will play a visual novel.
